sources.title: 《交食推步法》
sources.author: 李純之、金石悌奉命編
sources.historical_period: 朝鮮世祖四年／天順二年（1458）
sources.edition: 古活字本（大字丙辰字、中字甲寅字）
sources.quality_notes: Kyujanggak catalogs the 1458 Korean edition. Its preface says the method was developed from Shoushi/Datong materials for Joseon use, explicitly criticizes direct use of Chinese Datong sunrise/sunset values at Hanyang, and states that several difference/correction procedures were recast to compute directly without the original licheng tables. Its chiji interpolation divides by 820.08 and its dingxian-line-speed path subtracts 8.2008, so it is a valuable cross-regional algorithm-divergence witness but must not be used to overwrite the 1569 Zhou Xiang Ming D1 method.

sources.title: 《高麗史》卷五十二·授時曆立成·太陰限數遲疾度
sources.historical_period: 朝鮮王朝官修《高麗史》；1451成書，保存高麗受授時曆資料
sources.quality_notes: Digital transcription of the Goryeosa/Shoushi received tradition and useful as a second digital presentation, but not automatically an independent physical-edition witness. It agrees with KRDB o on several divergences from the Ming 1569 primary, including solar D16, lunar L8, L124 and L132; it aligns with Ming and KRDB r normalization on L114. Compact Han numeric surfaces such as L101 are parsed with positional awareness and are not treated as decimal digit strings. Direct physical-image comparison remains required for edition-level causal claims.

sources.title: 梅文鼎《歷算全書》卷二十一《曆學駢枝》
sources.author: 梅文鼎
sources.quality_notes: Explains the table semantics explicitly: limits 1–83 use 益, limits 84–168 use 損; row residual is multiplied by 損益分 and divided by 820. Used to explain and test the primary 1569 table, never to supersede it.

sources.title: 梅文鼎《大統曆志》卷四
sources.author: 梅文鼎
sources.quality_notes: Later Qing critical/explanatory witness only. It explains Datong lunar line-speed construction as mean per-limit motion plus/minus each limit's 損益分 and separately marks the 83/84 transition. For precision semantics it says `數止秒`; Wu'an's note says sub-second residue, however small, is collected into a second (`秒以下有零數不拘多少俱收為秒`); the alternate 布立成法 instead says `秒以下數不用`. This later wording independently explains stage-scoped collect-up versus discard-below-unit behavior, but it does not override the directly collated 1569 Zhou Xiang primary values or authorize one global rounding rule.

sources.title: 《古今律曆考》卷五十·萬曆三十三年乙巳歲二月望月食曆〈授時〉

sources.quality_notes: The worked example is explicitly labelled 〈授時〉, not 〈大統〉. It preserves unequal intermediate precision widths in 盈差、遲差、合差 and 推加減差. sources.title: 《授時曆立成》
sources.catalog_author_attribution: 王恂(明) 等奉勅撰（奎章閣 provider metadata; dynasty label is retained as catalog metadata, not adopted as an authorship-period conclusion）
sources.edition: 甲寅字本；15世紀前半（世宗年間 1418-1450）
catalog_contents: 太陽冬至前後二象盈初縮末限
太陽夏至前後二象盈初縮末限
sources.quality_notes: High-value independent physical witness for the Shoushi table transmission. Kyujanggak itself catalogs the surviving precious-book copy only as a first-half-15th-century, Sejong-reign 甲寅字 witness (1418-1450), not an exact-year print. KOSTMA and Li 2018 associate 授時曆立成/the extant copy with 1434, while Li's later 2022 numerical-table chapter cites the same Kyujanggak collection no. 893 as printed in 1444. Exact surviving-copy print year is therefore unresolved and must not be used as a weighting shortcut. Shi Yunli 1998 and other version studies still establish a substantive early Korean Shoushi-licheng transmission lineage. None of these bibliographic witnesses supplies the six pending target glyph readings. Batch 11U directly reads the 1940 internal 奎章閣貴重圖書目錄: page 0125 explicitly labels 書名/圖書番號/冊數/備考, and page 0129 directly records 授時曆立成 as 圖書番號 893, 1冊, adjacent to the separate 授時曆捷法立成 no.892. Together with the current provider title and 奎貴893 identifier and official collection custody continuity, catalog-item continuity to GK00893_00 is now resolved at identifier level. This still supplies no target folio, glyph, value, or exact print year. Batch 11X separately confirms the official institutional reproduction workflow: the G893 detail page exposes a reproduction-request control and the provider service notice states that microfilm reproduction is delivered by uploading a scanned PDF to the homepage after the request/approval workflow, normally within two weeks unless delayed. The public non-member cart records the 2024-02-01 change from postal paper copies to homepage microfilm-scan PDF publication. No G893 request has been submitted or approved, and fulfillment scope/cost remain unknown; this route supplies zero target-page/glyph/value authority until an actual provider file is obtained. Batch 12CW supersedes the former daylength-table access boundary: Actions run 35324088110 / artifact 10538746764 acquired all 204 source-bound Kyujanggak viewer pages. Direct no-OCR review of 052a reads 授時曆日出入晨昏半晝分 and winter-solstice initial values 晨2842.04 / 日出3092.04 / 半晝1907.96 / 日入6907.96 / 昏7157.96, yielding daylight 38.1592 ke. Direct review of 077a reads the summer-solstice initial mirror 晨1657.96 / 日出1907.96 / 半晝3092.04 / 日入8092.04 / 昏8342.04, yielding daylight 61.8408 ke. This directly fixes the G893 table to the Beijing/Yandu Shoushi numerical branch and disproves raw numeric identity with the 1578 Sanming 59/41 display. Exact surviving-copy print year remains unresolved within the provider's Sejong-era range. The six legacy G893 textual/numeric controls from Batch 11 are not silently closed by whole-volume acquisition and require page-specific collation.

textual_volume_localization.basis: Li 2018 states one volume contains Sun/Moon/five-planet tables and Figure 6 reproduces the solar table under the visible title 授時曆立成卷上; the Kyujanggak catalog lists the target solar and lunar table families.

sources.provider: 中国科学技术大学 / 《自然科学史研究》PDF
sources.quality_notes: Directly reviewable scholarly article. It states that the Goryeosa calendrical tradition preserves an attached Shoushi licheng containing solar winter/summer ying-suo, lunar chiji and planetary tables absent from surviving Chinese dynastic histories; it distinguishes the Korean independent licheng 'copy/set' from the Goryeosa history version and discusses early Korean derivation of licheng formulas in Jiaoshi Tuibufa. It cites Lee Eun-Hee & Jing Bing's 1998 specialist article on the Kyujanggak Shoushi licheng. This source strengthens transmission history only; it is not a direct glyph witness for any G893 target value.

sources.title: 한국학자료센터 활자·인쇄 연표의 《授時曆立成》 甲寅字 기록

This is a bibliographic print-tradition/date assertion, not a copy-specific colophon reading. It conflicts with Li Liang's later 2022 chapter, which cites Kyujanggak collection no. 893 as printed in 1444, while Kyujanggak's own live catalog only brackets the surviving copy to Sejong 1418-1450. sources.title: Astronomical Tables in the “Lü-li zhi”: On the Characteristics and Adoption of “Licheng” Pick-up Tables
sources.author: Li Liang 李亮
sources.publication: Chinese Annals of History of Science and Technology 2(2), 2018, 41–67
sources.provider: Chinese Annals of History of Science and Technology / ScienceEngine
sources.quality_notes: The indexed peer-reviewed full text states that the extant Kyujanggak Shoushi li licheng was reprinted in 1434, contains two textual volumes, and was a King Sejong-period reprint. It explicitly reports Lee Eun-Hee and Jing Bing 1998 as establishing identity with the version mentioned in Mingshi. Page 55 states that one volume contains the Sun, Moon and five-planet pick-up tables while the other contains sunrise/sunset tables. Figure 6 reproduces a Kyujanggak solar-table opening whose visible title is 授時曆立成卷上 and whose displayed block covers 初日 through 八日. The 1434 exact-year statement is retained as this source's claim, not project fact, because Li's later 2022 chapter cites collection no. 893 as printed in 1444 and the provider catalog gives only 1418-1450. The figure is strong localization/version evidence but not one of the six target glyph pages.

sources.title: 《朝鮮奎章閣本的〈授時曆立成〉》
sources.author: 李銀姬（Lee Eun-Hee）; 景冰（Jing Bing）
sources.provider: 《中國科技史料》CBPT/CNKI official journal portal; bibliographic corroboration retained from KCI/RISS and later scholarship
sources.quality_notes: Batch 11W directly resolves the official 1998-02 journal issue and target paper UUID, and directly verifies the paper title, authors, affiliations, publication metadata, abstract and reference-list surface on the journal's CBPT/CNKI portal. The official abstract itself identifies a one-volume Kyujanggak Shoushi-li licheng attributed to Wang Xun, assigns the underlying work to the Yuan-period Shoushi tradition and the Korean printing/republication to King Sejong's reign, and notes the four-dark-star material. The public article page does not expose the protected full text or any target computational plate; its full-text control routes to CNKI node ZGKS802.008. Therefore this source is upgraded from bibliographic-only to direct official record/abstract witness, but it supplies no G893 target folio, glyph, numeric value, or exact 1434/1444 print-year authority.

Its public Figure 1 visibly reproduces the physical Kyujanggak Shoushi-licheng object: cover 授時曆 plus an opening solar-table page with 授時曆立成卷上, the Wang Xun attribution, 太陽冬至前後二象盈初縮末限, and day headings 初日 through 八日. sources.title: Tables of Sunrise and Sunset in Yuan and Ming China (1271–1644) and their Adoption in Korea
sources.author: Li Liang 李亮
sources.publication: Editing and Analysing Numerical Tables: Towards a Digital Information System for the History of Astral Sciences
sources.provider: Brepols / Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften public chapter PDF
sources.quality_notes: The chapter's bibliography/reference key explicitly identifies Shoushili licheng, Kyujanggak collection no. 893, as printed in 1444. This conflicts with Li 2018's 1434 reprint statement and KOSTMA's 1434 print-history association. Because Kyujanggak's own live catalog only dates the surviving copy to the first half of the 15th century / Sejong 1418-1450, this 1444 statement is retained as a high-quality secondary date witness, not silently promoted to copy-specific fact or target-glyph authority. The same study classifies the Shoushi Type-II sunrise/sunset table as C-II-B (Beijing/Dadu) and the Great Concordance/Datong Type-II table as C-II-N (Nanjing); Batch 12CW uses that modern classification only after direct physical numerical collation, not as a substitute for the physical pages.

No explicit named-place/里差/地差/longitude locality operator is attested in the reviewed method block. sources.quality_notes: Batch 12ES directly re-reads p20 high-resolution physical render and closes the side ascription 依授時曆抄白 beside 四時加減晝夜節氣. Together with the directly read first row 冬至節日連小寒後四日同=晝38/夜62, this provides a securely pre-1578 physical Shoushi-ascribed fine-table carrier that exactly matches the 1823 Zhunzhai first-arrow date span/value. The inscription is direct evidence of the 1551 table's stated source tradition, not independent proof that every row is an unchanged Yuan original and not a pre-1578 witness of the Zhunzhai 25-arrow prose. Batch 12ET extends the physical p20 replay beyond the first state: the 62/38 terminal state directly reads 夏至節日連小暑後六日同; the 45/55 spring range directly reads 雨水節日至後五日同; and p20 physically preserves two sequence-breaking readings, 45/55 autumn 霜降前十日至後四日同 and 46/54 spring 雨水前八日至後十日同. The 1823 Zhunzhai p73/p76 provides clean parallel controls. These support a common Shoushi fine-table source family and two transmission-error localizations, not direct copy direction or a full 25-arrow replay.

sources.quality_notes: Batch 12DV direct no-OCR review. PDF p71 explicitly gives hundred-ke seasonal variation, twenty-five arrows, winter-solstice forward selection, summer-solstice reverse selection, and 日曆/節候 reference. p72 first arrow is 38/62; p76 twenty-fifth arrow is 62/38. p78 opens 銅壺漏箭制度 and p86 directly prints a 60/40 seasonal pair. These facts strengthen the historical discrete-arrow selection mechanism class but directly mismatch the 1578 Sanming 59/41 endpoint. Xuxiu metadata identifies the reviewed underlying manuscripts as Qing Daoguang-3 Huang-family Shiliju copies; Song work attribution is not a pre-1578 physical-copy claim. Batch 12EQ adds a 1441 catalog-text title-family antecedent (準齋九漏新式) from 《文淵閣書目》, but explicitly does not backdate the exact 25-arrow wording or the 1823 physical manuscript. Batch 12ER adds a chronology-attribution refinement: modern specialist scholarship argues for Yuan/Shoushi-period composition, and repository replay finds the 1823 first-arrow state (winter solstice through Xiaohan+4, 38/62) exactly matches the source-bound 1551 Leibian fine-table first state. This strongly corroborates a Yuan/Shoushi textual substrate but does not date the surviving 1823 manuscript or close the exact pre-1578 25-arrow wording. Batch 12ET directly uses source-bound p73 (SHA256 1984fab8...) and p76 to extend the 1551 bridge: arrow 8 gives 45/55 with 雨水日→雨水後五日 and 霜降前一日→霜降後四日; arrow 9 gives 46/54 beginning 雨水後六日; arrow 25 gives 夏至日→小暑後六日 at 62/38. This resolves/controls specific 1551 p20 anomalies but does not prove a direct Zhunzhai↔Leibian copying direction or close all 25 rows. Batch 12FA re-adjudicates the source-bound p76 Huang paratext and directly separates 原書舊鈔 from 錄副. The phrase 原書舊鈔當是影宋 is preserved as Huang's Qing bibliographic judgment, not as physical dating. This blocks automatic identity between the 1827 Airijinglu 從吳門黃氏藏舊抄本影寫 source and the currently reviewed 1823 Shiliju physical object. Batch 12FD source-bound p78 seal-column review closes the previously unadjudicated lower long rectangular seal as 鐵琴銅劍樓. Independent NCL catalog and journal controls identify that Qu-family mark as the 鐵琴銅劍樓 collector's seal / 白文長方印. This closes later Tieqin-collection provenance for the current NLC 1823 composite object, but the collection mark is not a unique inventory number; exact unique-object identity with the specific Tieqin catalogued copy remains very strongly supported, not formally collapsed.

sources.historical_period: KOREAN GWANSANGGAM MOVABLE-TYPE RECENSION; DIRECT 1434 TYPE-EVENT POSTFACE; DIRECT 1442 TERMINAL INTERNAL DATE; CURRENT CATALOG IMPRESSION YEAR UNRESOLVED
sources.edition: 觀象監活字; 刊年未詳
sources.provider: Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies, Seoul National University
sources.quality_notes: Batch 12EE directly reviews source-bound CSP/_IL_ images with no OCR final authority. Rainwater p002b gives 後五六日 47/53 and 後十三四日 48/52; Dahan p038b gives 後十三四日 44/56 and 冬至餘五十六刻三十分已上為退. p057a-p057b physically recover the 宣德九年/1434 Kim Bin type-casting and start-of-printing postface. The catalog still says 刊年未詳, so the postface is not promoted into the surviving copy's impression date. Batch 12EF re-adjudicates the separately printed p057b line 正統七年十二月日 as a direct 1442 terminal internal date and a textual-layer terminus post quem only. No adjacent 印出 marker is observed, so the surviving copy remains 刊年未詳 and is not promoted to a 1442 impression. Batch 12EG adds a bibliographic type/copy firewall: AKS treats 印曆字/觀象監活字 as a recurring Gwansanggam calendar-type category with repeated recasting and diverse impressions, while Kyujanggak GC00509 directly proves a 1707 Musinja reprint can retain a 1434 Gabinja 原刊記. Therefore neither the type-category label nor inherited internal imprint/date statements date GK02538 by themselves. Batch 12EH adds a direct dated physical comparator corpus (1580 Gyeongjin calendar and 1604 Ryu Gabjin calendar) beside exact GK02538 source-bound pages. Direct review shows annual-calendar page architecture is not a copy-identical layout control for the 12-juan commentary; exact dating now requires subtype/shared-glyph evidence. Batch 12EI adds official physical-scale control: the 25.3 cm frame height divided by 21 body-character slots gives a nominal 1.2047619 cm vertical pitch, compatible within 0.397% of the Heritage Portal 1.2 cm medium 印曆字 height. This is scale compatibility only and does not identify the casting generation or impression year. Batch 12EJ rejects title-based subtype assignment: a KASI scholarly bibliography still labels the matching 大統曆註 item generically 觀象監活字, while an independent bibliographic thesis citing Kim Sang-Ho 1987 p.132 uses 觀象監大統曆字 for later 1651/1652 大統曆 and 1653-1723 時憲曆. Therefore the title 大統曆註 is not a subtype identifier. Batch 12EK hash-locks fixed source-pixel 正/月/context crops from 0001/002a against the dated 1580 Gyeongjin control. The corpus closes reproducible shared-glyph access but not same-size-class, subtype, casting-generation or impression-date identity. Batch 12EM adds source-bound 大 beside 正/月 and a nominal medium vertical-pitch normalization corpus (run 35673107826 / artifact 10671577720). All three pairs remain visibly non-identical after scale normalization, but no subtype, casting-generation or exact-date verdict is authorized. Batch 12EN places this object in a source-hash-bound 正/月/大 three-way control with the dated 1580 and 1604 Inryeokja exemplars. The dated controls themselves differ visibly, so visual nearest-neighbor match/mismatch is not used as a standalone casting or dating operator. Batch 12EO replaces the earlier generic-medium two-dimensional comparison with an object-specific 1580 calibration: 正/月 month-heading glyphs are approximately 1.4×1.2 cm. GK02538 retains only nominal vertical compatibility at 1.204761905 cm; width/body equivalence remains unresolved. Batch 12EP adds the Imjin-war physical-stock firewall: prewar-to-postwar calendar type continuity is partial-recovery-attested but neither complete continuity nor complete discontinuity is proven. Therefore a visual nearest neighbor among 1580/1604 controls cannot date this undated GK02538 copy.

Batch 12FL additionally uses the study only as a target-specific provenance negative control: the author reports not finding the target two works in the consulted Qu-family donation list and leaves their exact NLC acquisition route unresolved. This nonlocation is not treated as exhaustive or as proof of sale.

sources.title: 《河洛派紫微斗数同步断诀论命法》气数位 received text
sources.quality_notes: Received modern text states Life as one, Health as six/一六共宗 and Career as nine/qishu, then applies qishu-palace transformations to the origin palace. The page attributes 同步断诀 to 司徒阳, but this public transcription is not a first-party publication, exact-edition witness or proof of invention/lineage. Used only as modern school corroboration.

sources.title: 《青囊经》received 一六共宗/河图数对 text

Used only for term/concept ancestry at the Hetu layer. Work formation, recension, physical witness date and Ziwei transmission are not closed.

sources.title: 姚承舆《阳宅正宗》卷上 河图一六共宗 received text

sources.title: 《紫微斗数精成》第十四章 河洛论断法 一六共宗 received text

It establishes an older flank-pattern tradition, but this batch does not treat it as a generic definition of 邻宫 for every rotating subject palace, an exact physical-edition glyph witness, or a direct transmission bridge into modern Zhongzhou terminology.

sources.title: IANA tzdb 2026e Theory and pragmatics — Scope and Accuracy
sources.quality_notes: Defines the location-zone agreement boundary by timestamps after the POSIX epoch 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC; explicitly states that tzdb is not authoritative and pre-1970 coverage is incomplete. Used for confidence scope only, not as classical Ziwei/Bazi authority.

sources.title: IANA tzdb 2026e asia source — China / Shanghai / Urumqi
sources.quality_notes: Represents Beijing time used throughout China by Asia/Shanghai and separately Xinjiang time by Asia/Urumqi; also warns that Xinjiang pre-1986 history is poorly documented. Supports explicit timezone-id semantics, not geolocation-based winner selection.

sources.title: Python 3.14 zoneinfo documentation — Data sources and TZPATH precedence
sources.quality_notes: Documents that ZoneInfo first searches TZPATH and falls back to the first-party PyPI tzdata package. Used to repair runtime provenance labeling when an installed tzdata package is not the actual data source.

sources.title: PEP 495 — Local Time Disambiguation
sources.provider: Python Enhancement Proposals / Python Software Foundation ecosystem
sources.quality_notes: Defines fold=0 as the earlier and fold=1 as the later reading of an ambiguous local time; distinguishes folds from gaps and explicitly covers backward/forward offset transitions beyond ordinary one-hour DST cases. Used as modern datetime semantics only, never as classical Ziwei/Bazi authority.

sources.title: Python 3.14 zoneinfo documentation — fold support across offset transitions
sources.quality_notes: Documents that ZoneInfo uses the pre-transition offset for fold=0 and post-transition offset for fold=1 and sets fold correctly when converting from UTC. Used to bind project runtime behavior to Python's modern operational contract.

sources.quality_notes: Official PMO explanation states that the date containing the new moon is the first day of the lunar month, the month containing winter solstice is month 11, and in a 13-month interval the first month without a principal term is leap. sources.title: 中国科学院紫金山天文台《国家标准〈农历的编算和颁行〉解读材料》

This is the strict numerical-conformance gate R1 has not certified.

sources.title: Hong Kong Observatory Gregorian-Lunar Calendar Conversion Table 1901-2100
sources.quality_notes: Official HKO table surface spans 1901-2100 and warns that moon-phase/solar-term predictions decades ahead may be uncertain by minutes; near midnight this can shift the relevant lunar-month or solar-term date by one day. It explicitly lists new moons on 2057-09-28, 2089-09-04 and 2097-08-07 among such cases. The published horizon is not exhaustive validation of this repository.

sources.title: Astronomy Engine upstream accuracy and model contract
sources.quality_notes: Upstream describes Astronomy Engine as a compact VSOP87/NOVAS-based library designed for accuracy within approximately plus/minus one arcminute and validated against NOVAS/JPL sources. This is useful modern astronomical infrastructure but does not establish repository certification to GB/T 33661's IERS-model and 1-second event-time requirement.

sources.title: 《元史》卷五十四·授時曆經上·步氣朔第一：至元辛巳立元與諸應隨時推測
sources.quality_notes: Preserves 至元十八年歲次辛巳為元 and 其諸應等數隨時推測不用為元 plus the initial received response constants. Used to separate epoch from revisable response constants; not a Yuan physical autograph and not a meridian statement.

sources.title: 《明史》卷三十五·大統曆法：授時續定閏轉交三應
sources.quality_notes: Contrasts Yuan received initial 閏/轉/交應 with Tonggui 202050/130205/260388, explains 閏應 +200 as 經朔改早二刻, and calls Tonggui 授時續定之數. Lineage witness only; direct Ming facsimiles remain arithmetic authority.

sources.title: 《高麗史》卷五十一·曆二·步氣朔第一
sources.quality_notes: Preserves 至元十八年歲次辛巳為元 with 氣應550600, 閏應202050, 轉應131904 and 交應260388. Used as a mixed-recension control; no meridian or physical-copy authority inferred.

sources.title: 邢雲路《古今律曆考》卷一·授時諸應隨時改革與至元三十一年三應改定說
sources.quality_notes: Interprets 諸應不用為元 as periodic remeasurement and attributes the three-response revision to 至元三十一年甲午. Useful Ming interpretation, not a contemporary Yuan record of the revision site.

sources.title: 《元史》卷十·至元十六年大都司天臺與上都等五處儀表監候
sources.quality_notes: Records 建司天臺於大都 and simultaneous instrument/monitoring deployment at 上都、洛陽等五處, plus Guo Shoujing's Shangdu-to-Dadu-to-south measurement mission. Establishes multi-site infrastructure; does not identify the 1294 eclipse revision site or qishuo meridian.

sources.title: 《元史》卷十八·成宗一·至元三十一年上都與五月司天臺/雲仙臺記事
sources.quality_notes: Places Chengzong at Shangdu from the fourth month of 1294, records fifth-month rites at 司天臺 and 雲仙臺, and records return to Dadu in the tenth month. This proves active Shangdu court-astronomy context but does not bind Guo Shoujing or the target eclipse observation to Shangdu.

sources.title: 《元史》卷一百六十四·郭守敬傳·至元三十一年知太史院事
sources.quality_notes: Records 三十一年拜昭文館大學士、知太史院事. It establishes Guo's institutional role in the target year but supplies no Dadu/Shangdu site for the response-constant revision.

sources.title: 《元朝名臣事略》卷九之二·郭守敬
sources.quality_notes: Records Guo's Zhiyuan-31 appointment as 昭文館大學士、知太史院事. Near-primary biographical context only; no observation-site or qishuo-meridian statement.

sources.title: 王鴻緒《明史稿》志第七·至元三十一年五月望月食差二刻與三應改定
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly reports the Zhiyuan-31 fifth-month full-moon eclipse discrepancy of two ke and Guo Shoujing's resulting revision of 閏/轉/交應. It does not name the observation site and is not a contemporaneous Yuan log.

sources.title: 《元史》卷一百六十四·郭守敬傳著作目錄
sources.quality_notes: Records 修改源流一卷, 古今交食考一卷 and 並藏之官. Used for bibliographic identity and historical custody only; it does not prove present survival or provide target content.

sources.title: 《千頃堂書目》卷十三·郭守敬曆算著作目錄
sources.quality_notes: Independently lists 修改源流一卷 and 古今交食考一卷. Bibliographic witness only; no surviving-copy or text-content claim.

sources.title: 《新元史》卷一百七十一·郭守敬著作目錄
sources.quality_notes: Lists 修改源流七卷 while retaining 古今交食考一卷. Because earlier Yuan-shi biography and Qianqingtang agree on one juan, the seven-juan reading is preserved as a late variant and not promoted without further evidence.

sources.title: 《崇禎曆書》所收《古今交食考》
sources.quality_notes: Catalog contents bind a late-Ming 古今交食考 to 李天經督修 / 湯若望等撰訂. It is a different work and must not be conflated with Guo Shoujing's lost one-volume title.

sources.title: 朱載堉曆學材料中的《古今交食考》
sources.provider: Chinese Wikisource / Gujin Tushu Jicheng reproduction
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/欽定古今圖書集成/曆象彙編/曆法典/第045卷
sources.quality_notes: The title 古今交食考 also appears in a Zhu Zaiyu-related calendrical layer. Title identity alone therefore has zero authority for recovering Guo Shoujing's lost work.

sources.title: 《中國通史》第八卷郭守敬生平事跡（現代二手資料）
sources.quality_notes: States that 修改源流 and 古今交食考 are among Guo's works now lost. Used only as secondary status context, not exhaustive global-survival proof.

sources.title: The Planetary and Lunar Ephemerides DE430 and DE431
sources.provider: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory Solar System Dynamics
sources.quality_notes: JPL states DE431 spans -13200 to +17191 and omits the DE430 lunar core/mantle damping term so it is more suitable for integrations more than a few centuries into the past. Used only as a modern diagnostic absolute-ephemeris layer, never as historical calendrical authority.

sources.title: Uncertainty in Delta T / Five Millennium Canon of Lunar Eclipses
sources.quality_notes: NASA summarizes Morrison/Stephenson uncertainty and states decade fluctuations give approximately 20 s uncertainty for 1300-1600 CE. Used to bound modern absolute-time diagnostic uncertainty, not to define Ming historical clock semantics.

sources.title: Measurement of the Earth's rotation: 720 BC to AD 2015
sources.provider: Proceedings of the Royal Society A / PMC
sources.quality_notes: Peer-reviewed Earth-rotation reconstruction used as a modern uncertainty/model background layer. It does not define any historical Ming or Yuan clock coordinate.

sources.title: 《元史》卷五十四《授時曆經上·推發斂加時》
sources.quality_notes: Preserves 日周=10000 and 推發斂加時: convert event fraction to 12 shichen/ke and count from 子正, with 子初 half-shichen handling. It closes internal clock-label mechanics only; it does not name apparent/mean solar time, longitude, or physical clepsydra realization for qishuo.

sources.title: 《元史》卷五十五《授時曆經下·步中星第五》大都與九服漏刻
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly gives Dadu polar altitude/day-night values and says nine-region day/night/mid-star rates follow local pole altitude; local leak-clock values may be established by instrument observation or water clock. This proves a locality-sensitive timekeeping module but does not bind qishuo small remainders to Dadu longitude.

sources.title: 《元史》卷五十六《庚午元曆·求朔弦望中日》尋斯干城里差
sources.quality_notes: The distinct 庚午元曆 explicitly uses 尋斯干城 as reference, derives 里差 from east/west distance, and adds/subtracts it from mean new-moon/quarter/full-moon remainder. Positive-control architecture only; it must not be imported into Shoushi/Datong.

sources.title: 朱載堉《黃鍾曆議下·漏刻》
sources.provider: Shidian Guji / 《樂律全書》received digital surface
sources.quality_notes: States Shoushi rising/setting and seasonal day/night behavior used Dadu gnomon/clepsydra, while early Datong changed sunrise/sunset/daylength to Nanjing; criticizes mixed use because eclipse east-west and planetary visibility procedures retained Yuan methods. Strong module-geography evidence, not a direct qishuo-small-remainder meridian statement.

sources.title: 《明史》卷三十一·永樂遷都後應天/順天晝夜時刻標準爭議
sources.quality_notes: Records that after the Yongle move to Shuntian, Yingtian winter/summer day-night timings remained in use; Zhengtong 14 briefly adopted Shuntian values and the Jingtai-era decision restored the Hongwu/Yongle convention. This is a daylight/sunrise-sunset module control only. It rejects the shortcut CURRENT_CAPITAL -> ALL_CALENDAR_TIME_MODULES but does not identify the qishuo meridian or clock standard.

sources.title: 《明史》卷二十五·嘉靖七年四丈木表測晷影定氣朔／一以元法為斷
sources.quality_notes: Records the Jiajing-7 four-zhang wooden gnomon used to measure shadow and 定氣朔, followed by 一以元法為斷. This supports observational/calendar-calibration purpose and Yuan-method continuity. It does not supply a local-shadow/clock to 定朔 small-remainder conversion, a qishuo longitude, or apparent/mean-solar/clepsydra identity. Same Mingshi astronomy surface as existing broader Beijing/Nanjing clock source; not an independent witness vote.

sources.title: 《明史》卷三十一·嘉靖二年華湘觀象臺逐日逐月測候驗合朔方案
sources.quality_notes: Preserves Hua Xiang's proposal for day/night observatory measurement, daily/monthly records through the next winter solstice, and verification of 24 qi, solstices/equinoxes, 合朔, solar/lunar positions and other phenomena against Yuan-era measurements. Used for intended verification semantics only. Received compilations differ on immediate administrative disposition, and no completed observation dataset or direct local-clock-to-qishuo-remainder operator is claimed.

sources.title: 《明英宗睿皇帝實錄》卷187·景泰元年正月辛卯月食卯正三刻／欽天監誤推辰初初刻
sources.quality_notes: Records 是日早月食當在卯正三刻, Qintianjian prediction 辰初初刻, rescue failure, and immediate Six Offices/Thirteen Circuits impeachment of 許惇等 for 推測不明. Stronger provenance than later Mingshi repetition. The target clause does not identify the observer, eclipse phase, clepsydra/tower clock, solar-time standard, longitude, or explicit locality of the actual-time label. CText and Shidian are digital transcriptions of the same Ming Shilu passage and are not independent historical witness votes.

sources.title: 中央研究院史語所數位典藏《明英宗睿皇帝實錄》卷187目錄單元
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of History and Philology digital archive
sources.quality_notes: Catalog lists item 00001d0055468 as 卷之一百八十七, 廢帝郕戾王附錄第五; 景泰元年春正月. This confirms the archival volume unit and chronology. Batch 12PN did not obtain/read the target image at glyph level from this surface, so it supplies no independent target wording or clock value.

sources.title: 《新法算書》崇禎五年月食初虧測候與壺漏／輪鐘／日星儀器定時
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly distinguishes initial-contact (初虧) predictions from multiple methods, 至期測候, and methods for 定時 including ancient clepsydra, wheel clock, and preferred Sun/star instrument measurement (平晷/立晷). Used only to show that Ming calendrical texts can explicitly bind phase and timing method when documented. It must not be back-projected to the 1450 Jingtai-1 bare 月食時刻 record.

sources.title: 《潛菴先生擬明史稿》卷五·景泰元年月食誤推
sources.quality_notes: Repeats 景泰元年正月辛卯 卯正三刻月食 / 欽天監誤推辰初初刻 / 失救護 / 法司論徒. Adds no target-specific phase, observer, clock instrument or event locality. Derivative historical witness only; not independent event observation.

sources.title: 王鴻緒《明史稿》志第七·景泰元年月食誤推
sources.quality_notes: Repeats the Jingtai-1 eclipse timing error in a later calendar-history narrative. No new phase, observer, clock-acquisition or locality semantics are supplied.

sources.title: 《明會要》卷二十七·景泰元年月食誤推
sources.quality_notes: Repeats the same event chain without phase, observer, instrument or explicit locality. The neighboring 明政統宗 citation applies to the preceding Hongwu calendar paragraph and is not promoted as a target-event source citation.

sources.title: 《欽定續文獻通考》卷二百十二·景帝實錄景泰元年月食條
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly labels the short item 景帝實錄 and repeats the event. Some renderings abbreviate 辰初初刻 to 辰初刻. This is treated as derivative abbreviation/transmission, not a second observed value or new clock semantics.

sources.title: ZJLib/Wikimedia Commons《國榷》第25冊（卷29景泰元年正月）公開物理PDF路由
sources.provider: Wikimedia Commons / Zhejiang Library backup inventory
sources.quality_notes: The public inventory explicitly places 國榷卷29 庚午景泰元年正月 in volume 25. Batch 12PP records the access route only; no target-page image/glyph collation or target-event semantic claim is made yet. Batch 12PQ executed the route: workflow 37614030769 / artifact 11478827349 rendered all 177 pages without OCR; PDF p112 contains the target. A separate source entry now carries target-page glyph authority.

sources.title: 談遷《國榷》第25冊卷29·景泰元年正月辛卯月食（PDF p112）
sources.quality_notes: Batch 12PQ workflow 37614030769 / artifact 11478827349; source PDF SHA256 71c0895b396f54b785145b1aa7b16884d80549d04eb893e3031a9ac63c735d81. PDF p106 opens 國榷卷二十九 / 庚午景泰元年 / 正月丁丑朔. PDF p112 SHA256 44f14d7b7580fb581c32f86949dda1416c4e9e5bc8cf0900021e0cfb73222657 directly reads 卯刻月食欽天監官以辰初刻被劾下法司宥之. No OCR is used for final glyph claims. It abridges Ming Shilu precision and adds no phase, observer, instrument or locality.

sources.title: 《明英宗睿皇帝實錄》第19冊卷187·景泰元年正月辛卯月食（PDF p10）
sources.author_attribution: 〔明〕孫繼宗等纂修
sources.provider: National Library of China digitized ancient book surrogate mirrored by Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: Batch 12PR reuses workflow 35007522124 / artifact 10411764656. Source PDF SHA256 8c917af7b8a86450b6fffe8eaba1264d6537d081fd19516f473c6b50d05be9a7; 108 rendered pages. PDF p2 opens juan 187 and p10 SHA256 8e431e1b51a8cf7b040564d94d18f120ac31b4418053b0abee9ffb30937c07e5 directly preserves the precise 卯正三刻 / 辰初初刻 event wording and 許惇 glyph. No OCR is used for final glyph claims. The page does not identify eclipse phase, observer, clock instrument, acquisition method, solar-time standard, or explicit locality.

sources.title: 《明憲宗純皇帝實錄》卷4·天順八年四月日食初虧預報對照
sources.provider: 識典古籍 Ming Shilu received-text surface
sources.quality_notes: The entry explicitly reports 欽天監 forecast 日食三分十四秒，酉正二刻初虧 and a competing 天文生 forecast 酉初初刻初虧. Used only as a received-text philological/mechanical control; not physical glyph authority and not an independent historical witness for the 1450 event.

sources.title: 《明孝宗敬皇帝實錄》卷162·弘治十三年五月日食虧／圓推驗對照
sources.provider: 識典古籍 Ming Shilu received-text surface
sources.quality_notes: The entry says 欽天監春官正李宏等推算日食謂寅虧卯圓，及期驗之乃虧於卯而復圓於辰. It demonstrates explicit start/recovery phase marking when comparing forecast with observation. Comparative control only; no back-projection of its clock semantics to 1450.

sources.title: 《明神宗顯皇帝實錄》卷477·萬曆三十八年日食初虧／食甚／復圓及測驗正控
sources.provider: 識典古籍 Ming Shilu received-text surface
sources.quality_notes: The record explicitly enumerates 初虧、食甚、復圓 times and later discusses 調品壺漏、測驗簡儀 and competing observed timings. It is retained only as a positive control for explicit vocabulary/record structure; its 1610 measurement semantics are forbidden from being projected backward to Jingtai-1.

sources.title: 《諸司職掌·禮部·祠部》日月交蝕救護儀注
sources.quality_notes: Received digital text preserves 若遇日月交蝕則預先行移諸司救護; solar ritual says 至期欽天監官報日初蝕 before the drum/ritual begins and waits for 報復圓; lunar ritual says 同前. This source-closes the institutional rescue-start endpoint as eclipse onset for the transmitted ritual, but it is not physical-glyph authority and does not identify observer, clock instrument, clock standard, or locality.

sources.title: (正德)《明會典》卷95·諸司職掌日月食救護儀注
sources.quality_notes: Received text preserves 日食儀注: 至期欽天監官報日初食, then rescue drums/ritual, ending after 報復圓; 月食儀注同前. It controls the received institutional transmission of the onset-to-recovery rescue structure but is not counted as an independent physical Hongwu witness or a 1450 clock-acquisition witness.

sources.title: (萬曆)《大明會典》卷103所傳洪武六年／二十六年日月食救護條
sources.quality_notes: Received Wanli Huidian text explicitly labels 洪武二十六年定日食救護儀, starts at 欽天監官報日初食, gives 月食儀同前, and separately transmits 洪武六年奏定若遇雨雪雲翳則免行禮. Use to establish a dated early-Ming ritual visibility/weather condition, not to infer that the report time itself came from direct visual detection. Later compilation is not a surviving Hongwu physical witness.

sources.title: 沈德符《萬曆野獲編》卷20〈改造漏刻〉晚明追述
sources.author: 沈德符
sources.quality_notes: Received text says 正統十二年十一月, then 是時禁中官漏循用新製不待言. A later writer's assertion about new palace clock use, not a dated workshop-completion document, not evidence identifying a 1450 eclipse observer, apparatus, solar-time coordinate or locality. Other modern received rendering has 宮漏/新制 glyphs; physical edition still uncollated; no independent physical witness increment.

sources.title: 《明會要》卷28正統十二年漏箭改造紀月異文
sources.quality_notes: Records 正統十二年九月 for the Peng Deqing / Inner Palace order, in conflict with prior directly collated 《英宗實錄》卷160 十一月甲寅 and late-Ming 《野獲編》十一月. Preserve variant as later compiler chronology, not a second contemporaneous order or evidence of completed work.

sources.title: 國家圖書館411999003250《萬曆野獲編》抄本第10冊（卷18、19、20）
sources.provider: NLC digitization surfaced via Wikimedia Commons Library backup
sources.quality_notes: NLC library backup metadata identifies manuscript 抄本, 10行20字無格, 10th fascicle containing 卷18-20, 145-page PDF uploaded 2026-08-31. Physical target 改造漏刻 not visually located or collated. Ming period in catalog is not exact copy date and old 卷20 cannot be assumed the later 30-volume recut 卷20. 12PZ 2026-10-10 source binary pinned: original PDF 145p / 46,469,798 bytes / SHA256 8e746faaadcd961c7983981d419862d97fdc2a1f3ec33ecb02046e9e79a6376c; PDF p136–145 rendered at 155 DPI without OCR, image SHA256s in evidence file docs/research/MING-DATONG-YEHUOBIAN-12PZ-CHINA-NLC411999003250-V20-TAIL-SOURCE-DIGEST-R1.json, GH Actions successful run 38029093566 artifact 11662045134. Only p137 卷二十 heading had prior direct reading; no target text or exhaustive negative. 2026-10-10 positive manual image re-reading: PDF p137 LEFT literally 萬曆肆拾伍丁巳卷二十 / 野獲編 marginal, p145 RIGHT ends 萬曆野獲編二十卷紀事畢, p139/p140 features 奏進七政曆數 and 氣朔轉交. All 10 p136-145 JPEG SHA256 locally cross-checked to runner manifest and images manually inspected. No 改造漏刻 title found in that ten-page bounded window; neither old20 whole-work negative nor 1827 printing equivalence proven.

sources.title: 國立圖書館（臺灣）02261《萬曆野獲編》20卷綠格鈔本
sources.provider: National Central Library Taiwan rare-book first-party catalog and Wikimedia backup
sources.quality_notes: Official detailed catalog identifies 綠格鈔本 20卷 6冊, 11行21字雙欄, shelf 204.26 02261, first-party image-viewer entry. Wikimedia backup NCL-02261 is 534 pages. Neither target passage nor alignment with late-recompiled 卷20 was visually collated.

sources.title: 《萬曆野獲編》現行分類凡例（三十卷四十八門之錢枋重編法）

No target-character early-copy glyph evidence.

sources.title: 井上進「『万暦野獲編』の版本問題」《名古屋大学東洋史研究報告》43 (2019):51–73
sources.author: 井上進
sources.provider: Nagoya University Repository / Nagoya University Society of Oriental History
sources.quality_notes: Official-host indexed scholarly PDF pp.67–68 discusses two old 20-volume manuscript recensions A/B with rearranged items across volumes; B mistakenly gives authorial 序 date as 萬曆三十四年丙辰 rather than 丙午, and B preserves material belonging to later 續編. Scholar proposes B may mediate textual variants inherited by Daoguang print. Reviewed through indexed excerpts and institutional journal bibliographic confirmation, not physical target-page or exact manuscript shelf-mark verification. Do not assume scholar's B is Taiwan NCL 02261 solely because both have 丙辰.

sources.title: 井上進「『万暦野獲編』校記（一）」《名古屋大学東洋史研究報告》44 (2020):81–99
sources.author: 井上進
sources.quality_notes: Research PDF indexed p83 explicitly compares A/B/C and late printed versions, including original 二十/廿 versus recut 卅, and notes redaction/insertion possibility. Paper itself is secondary textual collation, not an independent surviving old folio or target 改造漏刻 line.

sources.title: 臺灣國圖02260《萬曆野獲編》舊鈔本20卷、補遺及續編的公開掃描
sources.provider: National Central Library Taiwan / Wikimedia Commons surrogate
sources.quality_notes: Public file metadata: old manuscript 20v, supplement 1v and continuation 12v, 16 fascicles; 9 lines 21 characters; 1,000-page 179.47MB PDF part1 and a second 35-page part2. Catalog paratext cites authorial preface 萬曆三十四年丙午. Distinct catalog number/copy from 02261 green-grid manuscript. No target page visually collated. 2026-10-10 direct browser image followup for SECOND file 12047_2.pdf: p4 (1-based) LEFT reads 萬曆野獲續編卷第十二目 (contents), p5 LEFT reads 萬曆野獲續編卷第十二 (body opening), p3 is a blank separator; p6 continues body. This is ONE physical NCL 02260 copy, NOT two witnesses. Exact original PDF and rendered JPG digests not computed in this environment; do not claim SHA closure or decide 1713 補遺序 十/十二. FOLLOW-UP superseding old local-digest-pending statement at later date 2026-10-10: source PDF2 captured through exact GH Actions run 38028236031, sha256 bb97af8a82afbc3412d743ba6638ca919440709d35fc14ef6810629e9c2c2ff2 / sha1 b0ab33d76ec27457173f6285b920016a0f24cdab; 35 PDF pages, 5959699 bytes. Runner JPEG p4 sha256 9f0bd458bb8338874534f2f417eb6804f5dc4e7f5f40b9508f63907c637b6d76 (卷第十二目) and p5 800572b8cef27ed9577b9b91994d8881f638f63d4801851eec3601cc23ea08f2 (卷第十二), with p3/p6 neighboring pages, ZIP artifact 11660463958. Source hashes calculated, but external Commons first-party sha1 metadata not independently cross-checked; no printed target or 1713 physical preface. Same physical NCL 02260 copy. 12PZ 2026-10-10 independent Commons ImageInfo API (success run 38029093566 artifact 11661805364) returns SHA1 b0ab33d76ec27457173f6285b920016a0f24cdab and 5,959,699 bytes, BOTH exactly matching captured 35p PDF2 source; earlier SHA1 metadata precheck pending is now CLOSED for the digital object, not for copy-text or 1713 preface glyph. 2026-10-10 independent direct counterpart: NCL 02260 old20v PDF1 p592 JPEG sha256 f173d98c6ee32aba342ade6b377094f333871345c357284fc4f27a2d819942a2 directly reads 萬曆野獲編卷第二十目, with topical headings 聖母並尊/武臣好文/文士論兵. China NLC old20v p137 has a Wanli45 chronological heading instead; same numerical volume label does not imply stable content/stemma.

sources.title: 柏林國立圖書館 Libri sin.365/372《野獲編》1827扶荔山房刻本之數位目錄及 Beispielseiten 公開樣張入口
sources.provider: Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek and first-party reader
sources.quality_notes: Institutional record identifies publisher 羊城扶荔山房 1827, call number Libri sin.365/372 and sample-only digitization (Beispielseiten); first-party viewer link resolves PPN334378186X. SBB public API documentation permits IIIF requests of shape https://content.staatsbibliothek-berlin.de/dc/{PPN}/manifest; the object-specific manifest and target leaf have NOT been successfully fetched/collated in this review. Sample images cannot be assumed to contain 卷20 改造漏刻. Do not count print collations or 1827 text glyph votes. Follow-up 12PZ GitHub Actions run 38032118754 (success) accessed exact SBB public manifest HTTP200 application/ld+json 69,638 bytes / 38 canvases, METS HTTP200 73,209 bytes, public reader HTTP200; artifact 11662685894. Digital sample availability was confirmed, but no individual image/target leaf or 宮/官 glyph was inspected. 12PZ later run 38032962716 success artifact 11662377590 fetched 12/38 source-explicit full original JPEGs, all SHA256-pinned and human visually checked by two source-derived sheets (no OCR), headings cover/序/凡例/總目/卷一/補遺. No 改造漏刻 target heading in these 12 selected image pages only; remaining 26 and full 1827 print NOT negatively searched. Full metadata machine record docs/research/MING-DATONG-YEHUOBIAN-12PZ-BERLIN-38-SAMPLES-12-DIRECT-IMAGE-COLLATION-R1.json. Follow-up run 38033275797 artifact 11662512982 obtained and visually reviewed remaining 26 full original JPEGs: 38/38 official sample canvases now source SHA256-bound and manually examined; 改造漏刻 target not present IN THIS SAMPLE SET ONLY. No negative inference for full printed volume20 or source genealogies. Machine closure docs/research/MING-DATONG-YEHUOBIAN-12PZ-BERLIN-38-OF-38-SAMPLE-IMAGE-CLOSURE-R1.json.
